title: KNN Matching and Ratio Test
description: Begins with a plain-language explanation of two-nearest-neighbour filtering and 0.789 cutoff, then traces the corresponding implementation and its limits in currency-note-recognition-for-visually-impaired.
learning_objectives: Explain two-nearest-neighbour filtering and 0.789 cutoff in plain language and connect it to Currency Detection using OpenCV in ML/detect.py; Currency Detection using OpenCV in ML/utils.py.
Trace one input through the knn matching and ratio test stage and identify its output and assumptions.
Diagnose one failure mode or limitation before extending this stage.
prerequisites: Read project prerequisites and the previous module when present.
practical_outcomes: Trace the knn matching and ratio test stage through the cited source paths.
Produce a small test or diagnostic for two-nearest-neighbour filtering and 0.789 cutoff.
completion_criteria: Complete the three lessons and exercise.
Answer all ten module questions using material from these lessons.
Submit a short source citation and limitation note.
